content.value_statement: Prisma ORM v7 does not support MongoDB, so standard upgrade advice fails. This skill evaluates Prisma Next and provides a staged migration path.
actual_capabilities: Explains why Prisma ORM v7 is unavailable for MongoDB projects.
Evaluates whether a project should adopt Prisma Next or remain on Prisma ORM v6.
Maps v6 schemas, client calls, raw queries, and transactions to Prisma Next concepts.
Maps the db push workflow to Prisma Next migration stages.
Provides staging, index, validator, transaction, cutover, and rollback checks.
limitations: Prisma Next is Early Access, so interfaces may differ from this skill's verified source revision.
The skill provides guidance but does not guarantee application behavior or data compatibility.
Prisma Next requires MongoDB 8.0 or newer and the supported MongoDB driver.
Transaction migration currently requires direct MongoDB driver sessions.

use_cases.title: Choose an upgrade path
use_cases.description: Determine whether a MongoDB application should remain on Prisma ORM v6 or evaluate Prisma Next.

use_cases.title: Assess migration readiness
use_cases.description: Inventory transactions, raw calls, server requirements, indexes, and schema contracts before committing to migration.

use_cases.title: Plan a controlled cutover
use_cases.description: Prepare staging verification, read-only comparison, production cutover, and rollback steps for an existing service.

prompt_templates.title: Check my upgrade options
prompt_templates.prompt: My project uses Prisma ORM v6 with MongoDB. Explain my supported upgrade options and the main tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Assess project blockers
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository for Prisma MongoDB migration blockers. Check transactions, raw queries, MongoDB version assumptions, and package versions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a migration plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged Prisma Next migration plan for this application. Include schema mapping, API changes, migration verification, and rollback gates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a production cutover
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this proposed Prisma Next cutover. Identify data, index, validator, transaction, deployment, and rollback risks with actionable corrections.

output_examples.input: Can I upgrade my Prisma v6 MongoDB project to Prisma v7?
output_examples.output: No. Prisma ORM v7 has no MongoDB connector. Remain on the latest v6 release or evaluate Prisma Next after checking its Early Access constraints.

output_examples.input: What should I check before trying Prisma Next?
output: Confirm MongoDB 8.0 or newer and compatible package versions.
Inventory transactions and raw database calls.
Validate contracts, indexes, and document shapes on a staging copy.
Keep the v6 deployment available until verification passes.

output_examples.output: Compare read-only results first, enable Prisma Next writes only after validation, and retain the v6 branch as the rollback path.

best_practices: Verify Prisma Next behavior against the exact installed version before changing the application.
Run contract, index, validator, and query checks against a staging copy before production.
Keep Prisma ORM v6 deployable until Prisma Next verification and read-only comparison pass.
anti_patterns: Do not attempt a Prisma ORM v7 upgrade because it has no MongoDB connector.
Do not change the application to SQL as an implicit solution to the version problem.
Do not apply push-style production changes without migration history, verification, and rollback planning.

faq.question: Does Prisma ORM v7 support MongoDB?
faq.answer: No. Prisma ORM v6 is the final classic ORM major with a MongoDB connector.

faq.question: What is the forward path for MongoDB projects?
faq.answer: Prisma Next is the successor path, but its MongoDB support is Early Access.

faq.question: Can a project remain on Prisma ORM v6?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep current with v6 patches and security advisories when Prisma Next constraints are unacceptable.

faq.question: What MongoDB version does Prisma Next require?
faq.answer: The skill states MongoDB 8.0 or newer. Verify this requirement against the installed Prisma Next version.

faq.question: How are transactions migrated?
faq.answer: Use direct MongoDB driver sessions until Prisma Next provides the required transaction facade.

faq.question: Does the migration move production data?
faq.answer: No. The intended approach changes client code against the same database and validates behavior before enabling writes.
